about: scripts/examples mutants of the ts leg (X-rpc1). The example killers run under -tags ts, which needs Bun and a warmed Bun cache: go run ./scripts/examples -tags ts limiter.

mutants.name: e3-direct-empty
mutants.rule: Jobs rejects an empty draft even when called directly, without DraftOf's HTTP validation.

mutants.name: e3-route-missing
mutants.rule: RoutesCoverEndpoints refuses a table missing an endpoint.

mutants.name: e3-route-repeat
mutants.to:
http.Route{Value: endpoint.ShowJob, Method: "GET", Path: "/jobs/:id", Status: 200},
	http.Route{Value: endpoint.ShowJob, Method: "GET", Path: "/jobs/:id", Status: 200},
mutants.rule: RoutesCoverEndpoints refuses a repeated endpoint even when Match returns the same response.

mutants.name: ts-skip
mutants.rule: A ts program the leg cannot run fails; it never passes with its cases unrun.

mutants.name: ts-layout
mutants.rule: A ts/ folder and the tag ts go together.

mutants.name: ts-package
mutants.rule: A case's copy has its own package.json, so ergo-ts/bun resolves to the installed package.

mutants.name: ts-path
mutants.rule: The checkout's ergo is first on PATH for the content mapper.

mutants.name: r3b-hold-release
mutants.rule: A Hold's release runs on every exit, a stop of its caller included: a client that hangs up on the gateway stops the Ergo Hold, and its release is seen.

mutants.name: r3b-hold-wake
mutants.rule: An Advance wakes every waiting Hold, so a Hold the clock lets through is granted.

mutants.name: x2-same-origin
mutants.rule: One listener serves the RPC mount beside the page's files: /rpc reaches rpc.Answer, not http.Files.

mutants.name: x2-cancel-ended
mutants.rule: A job that has ended stays ended: a cancel of it is rejected (AlreadyDone with its state), never a second end.
killers: example:jobs-web test memory and test loopback (law CancelOfTerminalFails)
